title: Bree's Favorites — Frontend rollback to version 42 (deterministic deploy guard)

requirements.summary: Revert all frontend code and assets to match version 42, removing any post-v42 UI/behavior changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository state matches version 42 for both frontend and backend sources (no post-v42 changes remain).
A fresh build succeeds using the reverted version 42 codebase without internal build/deploy errors.
Deployed canisters and frontend assets correspond to version 42 behavior (no UI/functionality from versions >42 appears).

Ensure the HTML metadata/title and root wiring match the exact version 42 state (no post-v42 changes remain).

requirements.summary: Add a deterministic, single-source-of-truth frontend version pin/guard so builds/deploys consistently produce version 42 behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running the deploy process repeatedly results in the same version 42 artifact outputs and deployed behavior.
There is a clear, single source of truth for the deployed version (e.g., pinning to the version 42 revision/tag) used by the build/deploy steps.

file_operations.description: Add a clearly documented, pinned version variable (e.g., VITE_APP_VERSION=42) to serve as the frontend build/deploy single source of truth for version 42 selection.
Extend ImportMetaEnv typing to include the pinned version variable used by the frontend build (e.g., VITE_APP_VERSION) so version pinning is explicit and type-safe.

Create a small version-guard utility that reads the pinned version variable and validates it equals "42" for production builds, providing a deterministic fail-fast signal when a newer version is accidentally deployed.
Wire the version guard into app startup (without modifying immutable files) so a mismatched build/deploy version is detected deterministically and does not silently run a non-v42 frontend.
